correctness.rationale: The source Markov transition is exact. On the logarithmic grid, an ordinary step is the deterministic PDMP flow and the root doubling probability exactly matches the first-jump hazard. Coupling the remaining within-interval jumps bounds the local error by 2/k² and iteration gives an explicit L1 error for every finite log-time horizon. The PDMP is nonexplosive; compact one-jump density minorization, aperiodicity and LV=2-z establish geometric Harris ergodicity. This proves weak convergence by a two-limit argument without moment determinacy. Original established moment limits plus uniform integrability identify the invariant moments; E=2, E(square)=5. The standalone Python verifier passed 2,952 finite diagnostics, which are not substituted for the infinite proof.
